items.heading: Initial 12
items.text: Initial 12-month OPT: a maximum of 90 days of unemployment across the full period.
24-month STEM OPT extension: an additional 60 days, on top of the 90 already used or available in the initial period.

items.heading: Combined 36
items.text: Combined 36-month track: a maximum of 150 days of unemployment across the entire OPT and STEM OPT period.
